page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.small is an entry-level virtual server instance within the shared family, backed by the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, providing 1 dedicated physical core mapped to 1 vCPU with 1 thread per core. The processor features 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a 35 MB L3 cache, alongside instruction set support for AVX, AVX-512 (f and vnni), AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. Memory allocation is set at 4.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The instance includes no bundled local storage, no hardware GPU accelerators, and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data positions the instance in the lower performance tiers across standard computational workloads. In CPU testing, it achieved a stress-ng score of 1071.49 for both single-core and multi-core evaluations, placing it in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Similarly, Geekbench metrics reflect 944.0 points in single-core and multi-core testing, with software compilation reaching 1111.0 points and image processing registering 734.0 points. The PassMark CPU suite yielded a score of 1304.39, with an encryption sub-score of 402.83 and extended instructions at 1208.11, all placing in the lowest 10% comparative category.

Memory throughput and operational I/O metrics follow a similar pattern. Large-block uncached 256 MB memory bandwidth recorded 8.66 GB/sec for reads and 6.89 GB/sec for writes, while small cached 16 KB blocks achieved 79.6 GB/sec. Application testing yielded 1.3 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and 1.3 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. Single-threaded gzip compression processed at 18.6 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression reached 7.07 GB/sec. Data processing capability showed a PassMark database score of 526.2.

The ecs.n2.small configuration offers an economical entry profile for basic services where intense computing capacity and dedicated disk performance are not required. With its single-thread constraint and absence of onboard local storage, this instance is suited for lightweight background utilities, low-traffic internal web serving, testing environments, and basic automation tasks.
